name: set_font_scale
description: Set the font scale (text size multiplier) for a specific context.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: The font scale multiplier. 1.0 = normal, 1.5 = 50% bigger, 0.8 = 20% smaller. Range 0.5 to 3.0.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Which context: app, guru, or user. Defaults to app.
